name: smwmusic-rick-astley-robo-roll-never-gonna-give-you-up-chrono-trigger-remix
title: Rick Astley - Robo Roll ~ Never Gonna Give You Up (Chrono Trigger Remix)
description:
A remix of "Never gonna give you up" in the style of Robo's theme from Chrono Trigger. Original remix by TSSF, I extended it with the second verse and made it loop. Fit for scenarios where Mario won't give you up.

Note: not compatible with Bonus end, Thunder SFX/Blarggs/Fireworks and Yoshi.
